name: 18964 · Souderton, PA
findings: ZIP 18964 (Souderton) has 59 nonprofit organizations. 27 of them (46%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 20 organizations.
Community organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 18964 (Souderton) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 18964 (Souderton) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 3.6 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 19 organizations here; 34% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
